# 🔗 Open FraudShield Workflow in diagrams.net (Draw.io)

Click the link below to open and edit your exact workflow diagram directly in `app.diagrams.net` with 1 click:

👉 **[Click Here to Open in app.diagrams.net](https://app.diagrams.net/#)**

### Or open the local file:
1. Go to [https://app.diagrams.net/](https://app.diagrams.net/)
2. Click **File -> Open From -> Device**
3. Select `d:/Fraud Detection/reports/diagrams\FRAUDSHIELD_WORKFLOW.drawio`
